annotations.title: Register a buyer/renter for property alerts

description: Register what the user is looking for so OpenMoov emails them matching properties, including early "coming soon" listings. Requires email, name and looking_for (buy|rent|both); optionally phone, budget range in GBP (rent: per month), bedroom range and preferred_areas (UK towns/areas, e.g. ["Ashford","Canterbury"]). Creates a real applicant record — only call with genuine user details and explicit consent to receive property alerts.
